name: fluxmail
stderr:
Usage: fluxmail [options] [command]

Fluxmail, a self-hosted email API with MCP, REST, and CLI access

Options:
  --instance <name>                 Use a named local or remote instance
  -a, --mail-account <id-or-email>  Use an email account by ID or address
  --format <format>                 Output format: json, table, or ndjson
                                    (default: "json")
  --timeout <seconds>               Request deadline in seconds (1 to 300)
                                    (default: "30")
  --no-update-notifier              Skip the automatic update check for this
                                    command
  -v, --version                     output the version number
  -h, --help                        display help for command

Commands:
  setup [options]                   Create the first local administrator or
                                    claim a migrated administrator
  login [options]                   Log in to a local or remote instance
  logout                            Revoke the current CLI session
  instances                         Manage local and remote CLI instances
  auth                              Manage interactive authentication
  serve                             Run the HTTP server (MCP at /mcp and REST at
                                    /api/v1)
  stdio [options]                   Run as a stdio MCP server (for Claude
                                    Desktop / Claude Code local config)
  accounts                          Manage connected email accounts
  members                           Manage members (people using this instance)
  apikey                            Manage API keys for the HTTP MCP and REST
                                    APIs
  license                           Manage the paid-tier license
  config                            Inspect and initialize deployment
                                    configuration
  oauth                             Manage OAuth applications
  logs [options]                    Show recent local log entries
  telemetry                         Manage anonymous usage telemetry
  folders                           Work with navigable mailbox folders
  labels                            Work with Gmail labels and Outlook
                                    categories
  emails                            Read, send, and organize email
  threads                           Read email threads
  drafts                            Create and manage drafts
  scheduled                         Manage scheduled sends
  attachments                       Download message attachments
  status                            Show mailbox and provider status for the
                                    selected instance
  help [command]                    display help for command
